reviewPurpose: Evidence-backed prelaunch decisions. Pending is not a finding of infringement. No commercial activation is authorized.

checks.scope: Independent comparison or documented permission/licensing for non-boss pages, abilities, reference selections, original guide prose, Fandom adaptations and any externally sourced media.
Publish only approved generated content from a clean public distribution repository; move canonical third-party research and history to a private development repository.
Review indexed candidate pages for original helpful content, functionality, accurate caveats, non-duplicative intent, and usability on mobile.
Update live privacy disclosures for any future advertising/analytics; configure applicable consent management and verify requirements before loading tags.
Verify an owned custom domain, DNS/HTTPS, canonical/OG URLs, redirects, Search Console, and an approved indexable sitemap before broad indexing.
